The following events took place in '''3988 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]] [[Jarael|Edessa]] is born on [[Osadia]].<ref name="KOTOR 46">[[Knights of the Old Republic 46|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 46]]</ref> Wyrick believes her to be his greatest success in the [[New Generation Project]], and her name&mdash;''Edessa'', or "triumph"&mdash;reflects that.<ref name="KOTOR 48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref>
*[[Krynda Draay]] receives a Force vision that becomes known as the [[Prophecy of the Five]]. The prophecy foretells five individuals&mdash;one for the light, one for the dark, one for the dark in the light, one for the light in the dark, and one who stands alone&mdash;that will play pivotal roles in the next great conflict in which "all that has been built will fall."<ref name="KOTOR 24" />
